behavior: You talk only to the first mate, which dispatches, supervises, and brings you only the decisions that are yours.
Each crewmate works in its own visible tab you can watch or type into.
Each task runs in a clean, disposable worktree, so parallel work on one repo never collides.
Ship tasks deliver authorized changes, and scout tasks leave standalone investigation reports.
Each project ships through no-mistakes, direct-PR or local-only, with an optional yolo merge flag.
Second mates are optional persistent helpers that run from isolated homes with their own state, projects and session lock, locally or remotely.
A watcher wakes the first mate only when something needs it, without spending tokens on idle polling.
The first mate stays read-only over your projects outside a narrow set of operations, and crewmates make every other change.
All state lives on disk and in the session backend, so a new session reconciles and carries on after a restart.
One command runs session start once, so the captain gets one ordered digest instead of scattered reads.
The durable wake queue is presented raw at every locked session start and stays queued until explicitly acknowledged.
Bootstrap only detects missing tools or problems; it installs anything only after the captain approves in the current session.
A restart is a non-event: durable records and live backend state, not conversation memory, pick the session back up.
A dead or metadata-less direct report is reconciled and its unlanded work preserved before any new work starts.
Every request resolves to one project before work starts, asking the captain only when more than one plausibly matches.
Work is classified as a ship, an authorized change, or a scout, a report only, before anything is dispatched.
A ship task's delivery mode and yolo merge posture are resolved once at intake and recorded in the backlog note.
The selected delivery path owns its own review; no second manual gate is stacked on top of it.
With yolo off the captain approves every PR merge and every local landing; with it on firstmate merges green work itself, and never a red PR either way.
Teardown refuses to discard a task with uncommitted or unlanded work, and that refusal is a stop-and-investigate result, never bypassed.
A scout leaves a self-contained report before its scratch worktree is discarded, and that report is what promotion carries forward.
Promoting a scout to a ship keeps its window and context, carrying over only the intended fix, not its scratch commits.
Exactly one live supervision cycle runs whenever work is in flight, so no turn ends blind to what the crew is doing.
Every wake-handling turn drains the queue and reconciles open decisions and unread status before doing anything else that turn.
A signal, stale, check, or heartbeat wake each gets its own documented handling, from reading the event to escalating a real blocker.
While away mode is active the daemon owns supervision, and only a genuine unmarked message from the captain ends it.
A stale wake, a looping pane, or a failed steer triggers stuck-worker recovery before anything else is tried.
Every captain-facing message translates internal mechanics into the project outcome, using the captain's own nouns, never internal jargon.
Only work ready for review, finished findings, real blockers, and destructive or credential needs reach the captain; routine progress is batched.
A captain decision is simply a task held for the captain, closed only by his own recorded words.
Queued backlog work is re-evaluated after every teardown and heartbeat, and dispatched only once its blockers and time gates have cleared.
Every ship brief keeps the worktree-isolation assertion and stops the task if it was launched in the primary checkout.
A task that will drive Herdr lifecycle behavior is scaffolded to use the guarded lab helper, never the live default session.
/updatefirstmate fast-forwards this firstmate repo and every registered secondmate home from origin, without touching project work.
Relay stays inert and causes no behavior change until the captain places a pairing token in this home's private config.
A question that waits on the captain is carried by a real work item and closed only by his recorded words.
A note dropped while firstmate is busy is queued, listed, delivered once, acknowledged, and stops counting as waiting.
Do X as soon as Y is true is armed, held until the condition holds, fired, reported, and retired.
A worker pane made the production way runs the shell firstmate types into, and a plain pane does not.
Approved local work lands by fast-forward, and a diverged branch is refused instead of forced.
A real worker spawns into a visible tab, does isolated work, gets a checked result, lands, and is cleaned up.
A provisioned second mate home has its identity, owner, charter, routing entry, and working skills.
An instruction to a worker is refused rather than delivered to the wrong home.
A worker whose window disappeared is recovered without losing its work.
Work is delivered durably, survives until acknowledged with the generation it was handed, and leaves nothing behind.

A home reached by two spellings of its path is one home to every record lock: the command completes, the lock is released, and no takeover chain grows.
One request for three changes becomes three workers in their own tabs and copies, three landings on main, cleanup, and a healthy home, judged from records of a real session.

With a worker in flight the primary ends its turn, a tokenless watcher takes over with a fresh beacon, the worker's done line becomes a notification that wakes the primary, and the work lands and is acknowledged, judged from records of a real session.

A captain's mid-task instruction reaches the worker as a durable inbox record it acknowledges and that shows in its commit, cleanup refuses to discard the unlanded work, and the work lands only on the captain's word, judged from records of a real session.
